memory_update.text: APEI should be tracked as a customer/operator signal for LMS-as-operating-layer adoption because Rasmussen and APUS provide concrete evidence of Brightspace plus AI tutoring, feedback, content creation, and analytics adoption.

BNED is a potential second-order course-materials and digital-access chokepoint adjacent to LMS workflows, but the thesis depends on verifying LMS integration, inclusive-access economics, and publisher/platform bargaining power.

NNI is an underfollowed adjacent infrastructure candidate through education technology services and payments rather than direct LMS software; later layers should verify whether ETSP integrates with LMS/SIS ecosystems.
CHGG belongs in a speculative shadow lane as a displaced or repurposed AI tutoring/content/skilling asset; below-$300M market cap and business-model uncertainty require strict falsification checks.

The key node signal is not only LMS replacement but bundling: Brightspace, Lumi Tutor/Feedback, Creator+, and Performance+ suggest LMS vendors are absorbing tutoring, feedback, content creation, and analytics budgets.

Need a separate pass for non-US or private reference leaders, including D2L, Instructure, Anthology/Blackboard, PowerSchool, and private AI tutoring/assessment plug-ins, because they define the competitive map but do not meet the US-listed candidate constraint.

node: Learning-management systems expanding into institutional operating platforms
summary: This pass expands the LMS-operating-layer node using a two-lane funnel. The category reference is D2L/Instructure/Blackboard consolidation around LMS, AI tutoring, feedback, content creation, and analytics. Because the goal is US-listed exposure, the discovery lane focuses on public companies adjacent to LMS migrations: institutional operators whose platform choices reveal demand, campus-course-material channels that may integrate with or be squeezed by LMS bundles, education payments/admin software, and standalone tutoring/skilling assets that could be displaced or embedded as LMS-native AI expands.
